GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re settling further forward, rdr std she had been instructed to ride positively in the early stages settling in a position near midfield. She said after beginning well, from a wide barrier she elected to continue to ride along in the early stages to clear rnrs to her inside and settled further forward than intended.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 3 Wide 6 lengths. well back turn under pressure. saddle slipped in run. eased down in Straight # forget
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide throughout. When questioned, rider advised that passing the 600m her saddle had slipped back resulting in her mount resenting its positioning and placing her at a disadvantage and ultimately she desisted from testing her mount in the straight. A replay of the race evidenced that the saddle had slipped back. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths off leader/winner Clear All The Way Under Pressure x 400m, Just Kept Going One Pace - # couldn't quicken
